entries.title: Positive Test - LTE Single UE Attach and Detach Successful Procedure
steps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and record configuration details
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait and verify successful attach completion as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1
Verify UE is attached to the correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN in UE logs
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait and verify successful detach completion as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 by validating detach request and detach accept messages
Stop and save logs for KPI measurement
Repeat attach and detach procedure total 10 times and record all results
expected_results: Attach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations
Attach latency measured and recorded (min, avg, max) as per Table 5-3
Signaling messages confirm successful UE context and RRC connection release on detach
UE attached to correct LTE cell parameters in all iterations

entries.title: Positive Test - 5G NSA Single UE Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release
steps: Configure test setup according to test configuration and record configuration details
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait and verify successful attach completion as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1 (EN-DC Secondary Node Addition)
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN, NR-ARFCN in UE logs
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure including LTE Detach and 5G Secondary Node Release as per 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Wait and verify successful detach completion by validating detach request, detach accept, and SgNB release messages
Stop and save logs for KPI measurement
Repeat attach and detach procedure total 10 times and record all results
expected_results: Attach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations
Secondary Node Addition success rate = 100% over 10 iterations
Detach success rate = 100% over 10 iterations
Signaling messages confirm UE context release and RRC connection release for both LTE and 5G secondary node
UE attached to correct LTE and 5G cell parameters in all iterations
messages: SgNB release messages Stop and save logs for KPI measurement Repeat attach and detach procedure total

entries.title: Negative Test - UE Attach Failure Due to Invalid Cell Parameters
steps: Configure test setup with invalid cell parameters and record configuration details
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for attach completion or failure
Capture signaling messages to detect attach reject or failure indication
Stop and save logs
expected_results: Attach procedure fails as UE cannot attach to invalid cell
Attach success rate < 100%, with attach reject or timeout observed in signaling logs
UE does not register with incorrect cell parameters

Start logs to capture signaling messages

Stop and save logs
expected_results: SN rejects Secondary Node Release request as per scenario
Detach procedure delayed or failed due to SN reject

Detach success rate less than 100%

entries.title: Edge Case - Attach Latency Measurement at Boundary Conditions
steps: Configure test setup and document exact RSRP/SS-RSRP values near minimum coupling loss
Start logs to capture signaling messages
Power ON UE and initiate attach procedure
Measure attach latency from attach request to attach complete
Power OFF UE and initiate detach procedure
Repeat attach/detach for 10 iterations
Sort and record minimum, average, maximum attach latency values as per Table 5-3
expected_results: Attach success rate = 100%
Attach latency values accurately captured at boundary radio conditions
Attach and detach procedures complete without failure near minimum coupling loss

entries.title: Performance Test - Attach and Detach Success Rate and Latency over 10 Iterations
steps: Configure test setup with parameters recorded
Start logs to capture signaling messages
Perform 10 consecutive attach and detach cycles by powering ON and OFF the UE
Measure attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency for each iteration
Record all KPI values in tables similar to Table 5-2 and Table 5-3
expected_results: Attach and detach success rate = 100% over all 10 iterations
Attach latency within acceptable target range
No intermittent failures or increased latency observed

entries.title: Security Test - UE Attach Authentication and Authorization Verification
steps: Start logs to capture signaling messages
Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Monitor authentication procedure as part of attach signaling
Verify authentication success messages and authorization acceptance
Power OFF UE to detach
Repeat with UE configured with invalid credentials to test reject scenario
expected_results: UE with valid credentials successfully authenticated and authorized during attach
UE with invalid credentials receives attach reject or authentication failure
No unauthorized access granted

entries.title: Integration Test - LTE and 5G NSA Attach-Detach Interworking
steps: Configure test setup and record parameters
Start logs to capture signaling messages for both LTE and 5G NSA
Power ON UE and perform LTE attach
Verify attach success and correct cell parameters
Perform 5G NSA attach with secondary node addition
Verify attach and secondary node addition success
Power OFF UE to initiate detach including LTE detach and 5G secondary node release
Verify detach success and UE context release in both LTE and 5G NSA
Repeat entire attach-detach cycle 10 times
expected_results: Seamless integration and correct signaling across LTE and 5G NSA
Attach and detach success rates = 100%
Secondary node addition and release correctly handled
No cross-technology signaling failures

entries.title: Usability Test - Clarity and Simplicity of Attach-Detach Test Procedure Documentation
steps: Read and follow the test procedure steps as provided in the documentation
Attempt to configure test setup and perform attach-detach tests as per instructions
Note any ambiguities, unclear instructions, or missing information
Provide feedback on ease of understanding and execution
expected_results: Test procedure is clear, unambiguous, and easy to follow
All required parameters and steps are sufficiently documented
Tester able to execute test without additional clarifications

entries.title: Compatibility Test - LTE Attach-Detach with Different 3GPP LTE Versions
steps: Configure test setup for LTE Rel-14 parameters
Perform attach and detach procedure with UE operating in Rel-14 mode
Record success rates and KPIs
Reconfigure test setup for LTE Rel-15 parameters
Perform attach and detach procedure with UE operating in Rel-15 mode
Record success rates and KPIs
Compare results across LTE versions
expected_results: Attach and detach success rates = 100% for all LTE versions tested
No interoperability issues or signaling failures between versions
KPI values within acceptable ranges across versions

entries.title: Registration Test - 5G NSA UE Registration Request to Registration Complete
steps: Configure test setup and record parameters
Start logs to capture signaling messages
Power ON UE to initiate Registration Request
Wait and verify reception of Registration Accept from network
Complete Registration Complete signaling from UE
Confirm UE is registered with network
Stop and save logs
expected_results: Successful Registration Request → Registration Accept → Registration Complete sequence
UE registered and reachable in 5G NSA network
Signaling messages confirm registration procedure completion

entries.title: PDU Session Test - 5G NSA PDU Session Establishment Procedure
steps: Start logs to capture signaling messages
UE initiates PDU Session Establishment Request
Network performs PDU Session Authentication if applicable
Network sends PDU Session Accept message
User plane setup performed including N3 tunnel creation
Verify QoS flow establishment and session parameters from signaling
Capture SMF, UPF, N11, N4 interface messages related to the session
Perform PDU Session Release and verify session teardown
Stop and save logs
expected_results: Successful PDU Session Establishment with authentication (if applicable)
User plane setup and N3 tunnel creation completed
QoS flow and session parameters correctly configured
Session release performed cleanly without errors

entries.title: Handover Test - 5G NSA Xn Handover Signaling Flow Validation
steps: Configure UE to trigger measurement report to source gNB
Source gNB sends Handover Required to target gNB
Target gNB responds with Handover Request Ack
Source gNB sends RRC Reconfiguration to UE for handover
UE performs handover to target cell
Target gNB performs Path Switch procedure
UE sends Handover Complete to target gNB
Verify signaling messages and successful handover completion
Stop and save logs
expected_results: All handover signaling steps completed successfully
UE successfully moved from source to target cell without service interruption
No failures or signaling errors during handover
